actions_completed_with_note.name: actions_completed_with_note
actions_completed_with_note.value: "actions"."status" not in ('completed', 'verified') or ("actions"."completed_at" is not null and "actions"."completed_by" is not null and "actions"."completion_note" is not null)

actions_verified_with_outcome.name: actions_verified_with_outcome
actions_verified_with_outcome.value: "actions"."status" <> 'verified' or ("actions"."effectiveness" is not null and "actions"."verified_by" is not null and "actions"."verified_at" is not null)

approval_routes_subject_fields.name: approval_routes_subject_fields
approval_routes_subject_fields.value:
("approval_routes"."subject" = 'document' or "approval_routes"."document_type_id" is null)
        and (("approval_routes"."subject" = 'risk_acceptance') = ("approval_routes"."variant" is not null))
        and ("approval_routes"."variant" is null or "approval_routes"."variant" in ('medium', 'high', 'extreme'))

audit_log_platform_insert.name: audit_log_platform_insert
audit_log_platform_insert.withCheck: actor_id IS NULL AND ip_address IS NULL AND action IN ('subscription_changed', 'import_window_changed', 'client_created_by_platform', 'client_settings_changed_by_platform', 'ai_settings_changed')

document_imports_confirmation.name: document_imports_confirmation
document_imports_confirmation.value: "document_imports"."confirmed_at" is null or ("document_imports"."confirmed_by" is not null and ("document_imports"."confirmed_by_import" or "document_imports"."confirmation_signature_id" is not null))

email_queue_about_one_thing.name: email_queue_about_one_thing
email_queue_about_one_thing.value: ("email_queue"."category" = 'daily_digest') = ("email_queue"."notification_id" is null and "email_queue"."period" is not null)

risk_acceptances_lapsed_why.name: risk_acceptances_lapsed_why
risk_acceptances_lapsed_why.value: "risk_acceptances"."status" <> 'lapsed' or ("risk_acceptances"."lapsed_reason" in ('last_day', 'score_risen', 'category_changed') and "risk_acceptances"."lapsed_at" is not null)

risk_incident_links_removed_with_reason.name: risk_incident_links_removed_with_reason
risk_incident_links_removed_with_reason.value: "risk_incident_links"."removed_at" is null or ("risk_incident_links"."removed_by" is not null and "risk_incident_links"."remove_reason" is not null)

risks_closed_when.name: risks_closed_when
risks_closed_when.value: "risks"."status" <> 'closed' or ("risks"."closed_at" is not null and "risks"."close_reason" is not null)

risks_ratings_whole.name: risks_ratings_whole
risks_ratings_whole.value: num_nulls("risks"."inherent_likelihood", "risks"."inherent_impact", "risks"."inherent_score", "risks"."inherent_band", "risks"."inherent_matrix_id") in (0, 5) and num_nulls("risks"."current_likelihood", "risks"."current_impact", "risks"."current_score", "risks"."current_band", "risks"."current_matrix_id") in (0, 5) and num_nulls("risks"."target_likelihood", "risks"."target_impact", "risks"."target_score", "risks"."target_band", "risks"."target_matrix_id") in (0, 5)

risks_scores.name: risks_scores
risks_scores.value: ("risks"."inherent_score" is null or "risks"."inherent_score" = "risks"."inherent_likelihood" * "risks"."inherent_impact") and ("risks"."current_score" is null or "risks"."current_score" = "risks"."current_likelihood" * "risks"."current_impact") and ("risks"."target_score" is null or "risks"."target_score" = "risks"."target_likelihood" * "risks"."target_impact")

risks_rejected_with_reason.name: risks_rejected_with_reason
risks_rejected_with_reason.value: "risks"."status" <> 'rejected' or ("risks"."reject_reason" is not null and "risks"."rejected_at" is not null)

users_external_access.name: users_external_access
users_external_access.value: ("users"."kind" = 'external_reviewer') = ("users"."access_from" is not null and "users"."access_until" is not null)
